schema_note: Eight criteria grouped under IF, VQ and DP. Sample-dependent applicability is resolved in questions.jsonl. Applicable criteria are equally weighted within each group; group weights are sample-specific.

IF-Fidelity.name: Fidelity
IF-Fidelity.definition: Whether the requested operation, content, attributes, quantity, relationships, and reference conditions are satisfied.
IF-Fidelity.evidence_boundary: Compare the instruction with the result. Do not score visual defects, local blending, or preservation here.
IF-Fidelity.sample_applicability: Always applicable when the task dimension is available.

IF-Selection.name: Selection
IF-Selection.definition: Whether the operation affects the intended region, object, or instance set.
IF-Selection.evidence_boundary: Score which target was selected. Changes to other content after selection belong to DP.
IF-Selection.sample_applicability: Applicable when the instruction or a visible mask selects a region, person, object, instance set, or reference role from possible alternatives.

VQ-Integrity.name: Integrity
VQ-Integrity.definition: Whether the result is free of malformed geometry, anatomy errors, broken text, unintended artifacts, and unreadable detail.
VQ-Integrity.evidence_boundary: Inspect the changed or generated content itself. Do not score instruction compliance, contextual blending, or preservation.
VQ-Integrity.sample_applicability: Always applicable when the task dimension is available.

VQ-Coherence.name: Coherence
VQ-Coherence.definition: Whether edited boundaries, contact, occlusion, lighting, color, material, and sharpness agree with the immediate context.
VQ-Coherence.evidence_boundary: Score local integration only. Overall scale, composition, physical plausibility, and target correctness belong elsewhere.
VQ-Coherence.sample_applicability: Always applicable when the task dimension is available.

VQ-Presentation.name: Presentation
VQ-Presentation.definition: Whether the whole result is clear, readable, well composed, physically plausible, and visually usable.
VQ-Presentation.evidence_boundary: Score the output as a whole, including global scale and composition. Do not judge whether the requested operation was followed.
VQ-Presentation.sample_applicability: Always applicable when the task dimension is available.

DP-Context.name: Context
DP-Context.definition: Whether background regions, non-person objects, animals, and other non-target visual content remain unchanged.
DP-Context.evidence_boundary: Compare non-target visual content between input and output. Do not score layout or subject identity here.
DP-Context.sample_applicability: Applicable when an input or base image contains identifiable non-person content that the instruction requires, explicitly or implicitly, to remain unchanged.

DP-Identity.name: Identity
DP-Identity.definition: Whether each person's identity and unrequested human attributes remain recognizable and stable.
DP-Identity.evidence_boundary: Score people only: human identity and person-specific appearance. Background and spatial layout belong to other DP dimensions.
DP-Identity.sample_applicability: Applicable when a person in an input or base image must be preserved, or when a reference person's identity or appearance must carry into the result.

DP-Structure.name: Structure
DP-Structure.definition: Whether composition, layout, geometry, and unrequested spatial relationships remain stable.
DP-Structure.evidence_boundary: Score positions and relationships, not the appearance or identity of individual objects.
DP-Structure.sample_applicability: Applicable when an input or base image has framing, layout, pose, viewpoint, alignment, or spatial relationships that should remain outside the requested change.

ref/r1/object/concrete.task_definition: 保留单张参考图中的具体物体，在指令描述的新场景中重新生成
ref/r1/object/concrete.task_example: 参考这把椅子的外观，生成它放在极简书房中的图片

ref/r1/animal.task_definition: 保留单张参考图中的宠物身份和外观，在新场景中重新生成
ref/r1/animal.task_example: 用这只狗作为主角，生成它在海边奔跑的照片

ref/r1/portrait/face.task_definition: 保留单张人像参考图中的人物身份，生成证件照或新人像
ref/r1/portrait/face.task_example: 参考此人照片生成白底证件照

ref/r1/portrait/multi.task_definition: 保留单张参考图中多个人物的身份或群体关系，生成新合影
ref/r1/portrait/multi.task_example: 参考这组人物，生成他们在公园里的自然合影

ref/r1/portrait/attire.task_definition: 从单张人像参考图中提取指定的衣物或饰品，生成独立完整的产品展示图
ref/r1/portrait/attire.task_example: 提取人物佩戴的项链，生成白底正面产品图

ref/r1/text.task_definition: 参考单张文字或文档图的字体、版式和视觉语言，生成新文档
ref/r1/text.task_example: 参考这张海报的字体和版式，生成一张英文咖啡节海报

ref/b1r1/object/abstract.task_definition: 把参考图的风格或抽象视觉特征迁移到底图
ref/b1r1/object/abstract.task_example: 参照这张画的风格重绘底图照片

ref/b1r1/object/concrete.task_definition: 把参考图中的具体物体放入或替换到底图
ref/b1r1/object/concrete.task_example: 把参考图里的沙发放进这个客厅

ref/b1r1/animal.task_definition: 把参考图中的宠物放入底图，或把参考配饰迁移到底图宠物身上
ref/b1r1/animal.task_example: 把参考图里的狗放到草地场景中

ref/b1r1/portrait/body.task_definition: 让底图人物采用参考图姿态，保持底图人物身份
ref/b1r1/portrait/body.task_example: 让底图人物摆出参考图里的姿势

ref/b1r1/portrait/face.task_definition: 把参考图的面部身份、妆容、美瞳、五官属性或发型迁移到底图人物；换脸时身份来自参考图，姿态、表情、发型、服装、光照和背景来自底图
ref/b1r1/portrait/face.task_example: 将参考人物的面部身份换到底图人物上，保留底图的姿态、表情、发型和背景

ref/b1r1/portrait/multi.task_definition: 把参考图中的人物加入底图合影，并保持其他人物不变
ref/b1r1/portrait/multi.task_example: 把参考图中的人自然地放进底图合影最右侧

ref/b1r1/portrait/attire.task_definition: 把参考图的衣物、饰品或美甲迁移到底图人物
ref/b1r1/portrait/attire.task_example: 让底图人物试穿参考图里的连衣裙

ref/b1r1/text.task_definition: 把参考图的字体或版式迁移到底图中的指定文字
ref/b1r1/text.task_example: 用参考图的字体样式改写底图中的标题

ref/b1r2/mixed.task_definition: 输入一张底图和两张角色明确的参考图，将两种独立参考信息组合到底图，并保持底图非目标内容
ref/b1r2/mixed.task_example: 让底图人物使用图2的面部身份和图3的发型，保留底图的姿态、服装和背景

ref/b1r3/mixed.task_definition: 输入一张底图和三张角色明确的参考图，将三种参考主体或属性组合到底图，用于测试跨图绑定和冲突消解
ref/b1r3/mixed.task_example: 把图2的人物、图3的宠物和图4的行李自然加入底图场景，并保持各自外观
